title: Tool library file: .camtools drops the drawn cutter (ToolCutter) on export and import
body:
**What happens**

A tool can have a drawn cutter outline (`ToolCutter`, #93 slice 2). The project file (`.camproj`) keeps it in `ToolDto::cutter`. The tool library file (`.camtools`) does not keep it:

- `export_tool_library` (`crates/app/src/tool_library.rs`, lines 94-129) writes the tool, its `body` or `holder`, and no `cutter`.
- `parse_tool_library` (lines 137-191) does not read a `cutter` key. `LibraryTool` has no cutter field.
- `ImportTools` (`crates/app/src/commands/tool_import/mod.rs`) sets the tool and its body only.

Thus an export and an import give a tool without its drawn cutter.

**Expected**

- Export writes the drawn cutter of each tool that has one, as `[z, r, arc]` points (the `.camproj` form).
- Import reads it and judges it against the tool numbers (`tool_body_wire::cutter_from_dto`, the same check as the project loader). A cutter that disagrees refuses the whole file by tool name.
- `ImportTools` Add, Update and Replace set the cutter, and undo restores the previous cutter, in one undo step.
- A file with a cutter says a new version (5). An older build then refuses the file by version. It does not drop the cutter silently.
- A file without a cutter keeps version 4 or lower, so older builds still read it.

**Why it matters**

- Since #852 the stack laws read the drawn neck of a cutter. A tool that loses its cutter in a library round trip is a different tool for those laws.
- The form mill kind (#3369, plan step D2) keeps its outline in this field. Without this fix, a form mill exported to a library loses its shape.
- This is a leftover of #93 (see the research comment on #93, item 4).

**Done means:** a tool with a drawn cutter makes the same tool after export and import; a cutter that disagrees refuses the file by name; Update replaces the cutter in one undo step; a library without a cutter keeps version 4 or lower. Pinned by tests in `crates/app/tests/tool_library.rs`.

Part of #3663 (plan step D3a). Refs #93.

The filer (qsmits) cannot set labels. A collaborator: please set a priority and an effort label, and `source:agent`. The parent #3663 is `P4`. This changes a file format, thus `effort:high` by the AGENTS.md effort table.
